shabby at snagging the old
bugs, huh, {04 1f 00}?
{07 0b 00}Are you up for a little
challenge? {01 00 00 05 00}Let's see who
can catch the rarest bug!
We'll be able to experience
the thrill of knowing
{07 0c 00}{01 02 00}"This is it!"{01 03 00}{01 00 00 14 00}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I hear you're quite the
bug catcher, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0b 00}Are you up for a challenge?
{07 14 00}What I've got in mind is
that you and I see who can
catch the rarest bug.
What you want is something
that makes you scream out,
{07 0c 00}"Eureka! I have found you!"{01 00 00 0f 00}
.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}{07 00 00}That's the sort of bug
I'm talking about. Show
it to me, and I'll judge it.
{07 14 00}Whoever has the most rare
bug wins, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 0b 00}Up for it, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma kuulen, et sa oled päris
putukapüüdja, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0b 00}Kas võtame mõõtu?
{07 14 00}Mul on mõttes see, et sina
ja mina vaatame, kes püüab
haruldaseima putuka.
Sa tahad midagi, mis paneb
sind hüüdma:
{07 0c 00}„Heureka! Ma leidsin su!”{01 00 00 0f 00}
.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}{07 00 00}Sellisest putukast ma
räägingi. Näita seda mulle
ja ma hindan seda.
{07 14 00}Kellel on kõige haruldasem
putukas, võidab, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 0b 00}Oled valmis, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you seem like
a sensitive sort... I don't
wanna hurt your feelings.
{07 15 00}But I've got to know which
of us is the better bug
snatcher, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0c 00}I've got it! We'll compete to
see who can find the most
uncommon insect!
{07 00 00}I'll give you a little time
to find the most incredibly
rare bug this season.
When you think you've got
it, bring it to me, and I'll
be the judge, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Once I've seen what you've
got, we'll find out who's
the mightiest bug hunter!
{07 0b 00}So, what do you say? Have
we got a deal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sa tundud
tundliku tüübina... Ma ei
taha sulle haiget teha.
{07 15 00}Aga ma pean teadma, kumb
meist on parem putuka-
püüdja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0c 00}Sain mõtte! Me võistleme,
et näha, kes leiab kõige
haruldasema putuka!
{07 00 00}Ma annan sulle veidi aega,
et leida sel hooajal kõige
haruldasema putuka.
Kui arvad, et sul on see
olemas, too see mulle ja
mina hindan, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Kui ma olen näinud, mis
sul on, saame teada, kes on
vägevaim putukajahtija!
{07 0b 00}Nii, mis sa ütled? Kas
meil on tehing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
